acceptanceCriteria: A preregistration file (case digest, bars, pins, runner digest, one command) is committed before the run and its digest is recorded in a decision.
The run executes exactly once and its report is committed unrepaired under benchmarks/results/ with partition heldout-v7.
README's retrieval row states that run's numbers, pass or fail, and names v7 as consumed; the development corpus gains the v7 cases afterwards.
body: Decision 0427 / build-log 2026-10-01. No sealed retrieval partition remains (decision 0307: v4 retired, v5 and v6 consumed). The sibling explain-away rule (GPK-V0-040) is validated only on the development corpus and on probes; a window-licence floor variant was tried and not adopted (decision 0427). Authoring guide from the retrieval review: preregister a pool of about 15 repositories never indexed by Corvint and pick 5 by a committed coin (hash of a named future upstream tag); author on a machine without the corvint binary using only source and git grep; about 30 positive cases (task of at most 15 words from an issue or commit subject, never symbol names; expected files and symbols; 1 to 3 decoys each with a one-line reason: nearest-name same-file sibling, adjacent declaration, same-named symbol elsewhere) and 10 out-of-scope probes that are within-repository near misses (a feature the repository lacks beside ones it has; never a misspelling of a real behaviour, never a cross-repository transplant: the 45 transplant probes recorded in the build-log answer READY 22 times on declarations that legitimately carry two task words); a preregistration digest over the case file, the five metrics and their bars (top-5 above the exact-search baseline by at least 0.1; must-exclude over all emitted results 0; abstention precision at least 0.8 and recall at least 0.7; latency at most 5 s per case), exactly one run, and one appeal route: a second person may void one decoy as mis-authored before seeing any other output, after which that case is development.
title: Commission blind-v7: a held-out retrieval partition with reviewed decoys and within-repository out-of-scope probes
